svg.title: Startup: SomeipdService first, bridged services after

g.text: Startup: SomeipdService first, bridged services after
Typed skeleton, offered before any bridged
service below and before any service from
the network. Mirrors someipd starting its
IPC server before its network services.
start() returned success on the someipd side.
is_connected() turns true on the gatewayd side
as soon as the SomeipdServiceProxy exists, i.e.
before any bridged service is available, and
back to false if someipd stops.
